about.title: Bông Cún, where pets are treated like family
about.intro: We sell food and accessories and run a grooming spa for dogs and cats. Every product is chosen with care and every pet at the spa gets full attention.
about.missionText: Make pet care easy, correct and fairly priced for every owner.
about.v1Text: Clear sourcing, expiry tracked per batch.
about.v2Text: Bath and grooming by species and weight, transparent prices.
about.v3Text: Straight answers, no pushing what your pet does not need.
